miranda.note: chromaticity of planet-bake's baked level-0 albedo (procedural: the config's colour (disc-integrated colour B-V 0.64, V-R 0.52 (Karkoschka 2001, Icarus 151:51, table VIII (HST)); tint = relative reflectance (R, V, B) as linear sRGB (R, G, B): rho_B/rho_V = 10^(-0.4 ((B-V) - (B-V)sun)), rho_R/rho_V = 10^(0.4 ((V-R) - (V-R)sun)), or without V-R the B-V slope continued linearly in wavelength (B 440, V 550, R 640 nm: rho_R/rho_V = (rho_V/rho_B)^(90/110)); (B-V)sun 0.65, (V-R)sun 0.53 (Johnson, as Karkoschka 2001); brightening of fresh crater interiors and ejecta))

ariel.note: chromaticity of planet-bake's baked level-0 albedo (procedural: the config's colour (disc-integrated colour B-V 0.66, V-R 0.55 (Karkoschka 2001, Icarus 151:51, table VIII (HST)); tint = relative reflectance (R, V, B) as linear sRGB (R, G, B): rho_B/rho_V = 10^(-0.4 ((B-V) - (B-V)sun)), rho_R/rho_V = 10^(0.4 ((V-R) - (V-R)sun)), or without V-R the B-V slope continued linearly in wavelength (B 440, V 550, R 640 nm: rho_R/rho_V = (rho_V/rho_B)^(90/110)); (B-V)sun 0.65, (V-R)sun 0.53 (Johnson, as Karkoschka 2001); brightening of fresh crater interiors and ejecta))

umbriel.note: chromaticity of planet-bake's baked level-0 albedo (procedural: the config's colour (disc-integrated colour B-V 0.66, V-R 0.54 (Karkoschka 2001, Icarus 151:51, table VIII (HST)); tint = relative reflectance (R, V, B) as linear sRGB (R, G, B): rho_B/rho_V = 10^(-0.4 ((B-V) - (B-V)sun)), rho_R/rho_V = 10^(0.4 ((V-R) - (V-R)sun)), or without V-R the B-V slope continued linearly in wavelength (B 440, V 550, R 640 nm: rho_R/rho_V = (rho_V/rho_B)^(90/110)); (B-V)sun 0.65, (V-R)sun 0.53 (Johnson, as Karkoschka 2001); brightening of fresh crater interiors and ejecta))
